basis: Three original clean-context A→B→A Discovery videos and 5% samples. Desktop p000/p010/p020/p030/p045/p060/p075/p090/p100, portrait p000/p025/p050/p065/p100, landscape p000/p045/p065/p100 were inspected. Targets are approximate observed-state sampling positions; continuous video and telemetry provide transition bounds.

milestones.label: M01
milestones.observedChange: The front-on 1:20 ink facade shifts obliquely; the same door, window and zigzag diaper/header pattern acquire visible depth.

milestones.label: M02
milestones.observedChange: A luminous spatial boundary begins replacing the hatched paper facade with brick/material on the same patterned wall.

milestones.label: M03
milestones.observedChange: Brick, burnt headers, mortar, window and porch appear fully materialized in their original drawn locations.

milestones.label: M04
milestones.observedChange: The sun moves lower and more along the wall; shadows lengthen from the physically proud headers and the diaper pattern becomes more legible.

milestones.label: M05
milestones.observedChange: Raking light is settled; the same 60 mm-style header relief now has long directional shadows, with no new facade geometry introduced during the light shift.

milestones.label: M06
milestones.observedChange: The camera moves close enough to inspect projecting burnt headers, buff stretcher courses, mortar and relief shadows as material detail.

milestones.label: M07
milestones.observedChange: The camera follows the same patterned wall toward the deep porch reveal and original oak door.

milestones.label: M08
milestones.observedChange: The oak door opens inward while the bond and porch remain spatially continuous with the wall detail.

milestones.label: M09
milestones.observedChange: The route reaches the interior with timber stair, floor and rear glazing; donor sample-panel CTA overlays the final view.

reverseSemanticStates: Review continuous natural B→A for door closure, camera pullback from header detail, raking sun reset, material-to-ink front and restored hatching/intro/HUD. Compare A0/A1 separately in all three viewports; do not claim internal resource identity from visual equality.
